title: Organization and Structure of IG Metall
text:
Organization and Structure of IG Metall

## Nonpartisan, financially independent, and well-connected: IG Metall has a democratic structure and is organized from the bottom up. It all starts with the member. 

 Foto: Thomas Range 

## IG Metall—a democratic organization 

## Members have a say Structure of IG Metall 

 Nearly half a million workers have participated in warning strikes so far. IG Metall is even offering limited deviations from the collective bargaining agreement to fund investments in the future. However, metal industry employers continue to stonewall in the collective bargaining negotiations. The IG Metall executive board has therefore decided to call for full-day warning strikes. 

 For employees, flexible work schedules are often associated with less rest, greater exhaustion, and a poorer work-life balance. This is shown by a recent analysis. 

 Employment Law All answers about termination agreements 

 A termination agreement is a common way to end an employment relationship. However, employees should not sign one hastily. That’s because termination agreements have their pitfalls. Here’s what those affected need to know. 

 Long-Term Care Reform Making long-term care affordable: But fair! 

 The long-term care insurance system is running out of money. The federal government wants to plug the gaps with an austerity bill. But that would mean new hardships for millions of people in need of care and their families. Yet there is a socially responsible alternative to mere benefit cuts. 

 DGB Good Work Index Many workers are exposed to high levels of physical strain 

 Physical strain is a defining feature of the work of many industrial workers. This is shown by a new analysis. The figures also show that employees exposed to multiple sources of work-related strain are more likely to work even when they are sick. There is an urgent need for more preventive measures in the workplace. 

 Strengthen, Don’t Cut: A fair pension reform is possible, even if many claim the opposite. The new plan from the DGB unions shows how a change in pension policy can work—and how a decent standard of living in old age can be secured for everyone.
